input: What is the primary function of mitochondria?
expected_output: Generate cellular ATP through oxidative phosphorylation.

retrieved_chunks.text: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the biochemical reactions through ATP production.
Photosynthesis occurs within chloroplasts in plant cells.

input: When was the first Apollo moon landing?

retrieved_chunks.text: Apollo 11 was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon on July 20, 1969.
